units.clinx-rust-authority.service:
[Unit]
Description=CLINX sole Rust business authority (staged)
After=network.target
[Service]
User=clinx-authority
Group=clinx-authority
SupplementaryGroups=clinx-ipc clinx-provider-ipc
ExecStart=/release/clinx-runtime --state-dir /var/lib/clinx-rust/authority --socket /run/clinx-rust/authority.sock --policy /var/lib/clinx-rust/config/policy.json --caller-uid 1202 --transport-uid 1203
BindReadOnlyPaths=/desktop:/tmp/codex-daemon-1200
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/clinx-rust/authority /run/clinx-rust
NoNewPrivileges=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=

ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=read-only
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
ProtectProc=invisible

ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
RestrictRealtime=yes
LockPersonality=yes
UMask=0077
KillMode=control-group
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
units.clinx-rust-dispatcher.service:
[Unit]
Description=CLINX Rust native and Host execution transport
After=clinx-rust-authority.service
Requires=clinx-rust-authority.service
[Service]
User=clinx-transport
Group=clinx-transport
SupplementaryGroups=clinx-ipc
Environment=CLINX_AUTHORITY=rust
Environment=CLINX_RUST_SOCKET=/run/clinx-rust/authority.sock
Environment=CLINX_RUST_UID=1201
Environment=CLINX_RUST_NATIVE_TRANSPORT=/release/clinx-native-transport
Environment=CLINX_RUST_WORKER_LAUNCHER=/release/host-worker
ExecStart=/release/clinx-native-transport --socket /run/clinx-rust/authority.sock --authority-uid 1201 --host-config /var/lib/clinx-rust/config/host-runtime.json
BindReadOnlyPaths=/desktop:/tmp/codex-daemon-1200
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/clinx-rust/transport
InaccessiblePaths=/var/lib/clinx-rust/authority /run/clinx-rust-api /run/user/1001 -/run/docker.sock -/run/containerd
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_SETUID CAP_SETGID

ProtectSystem=no
ProtectHome=no
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
ProtectProc=invisible
ProcSubset=pid
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
RestrictRealtime=yes
LockPersonality=yes
UMask=0077
KillMode=control-group
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3

units.clinx-rust-mcp.socket:
[Unit]
Description=CLINX existing MCP transport socket for dedicated API identity
[Socket]
ListenStream=/run/clinx-rust-api/mcp.sock
Accept=yes
SocketUser=operator
SocketGroup=1204
SocketMode=0660
DirectoryMode=0711
RemoveOnStop=yes
units.clinx-rust-mcp@.service:
[Unit]
Description=CLINX MCP API adapter
After=clinx-rust-authority.service
Requires=clinx-rust-authority.service
[Service]
Environment=HOME=/var/lib/clinx-rust/api
Environment=PYTHONPATH=/release/control:/release/deps
Environment=PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
Environment=CLINX_AUTHORITY=rust
Environment=CLINX_RUST_SOCKET=/run/clinx-rust/authority.sock
Environment=CLINX_RUST_UID=1201
User=clinx-api
Group=clinx-api
SupplementaryGroups=clinx-ipc clinx-provider-ipc
NoNewPrivileges=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=read-only
ProtectProc=invisible
ProcSubset=pid
PrivateDevices=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
BindReadOnlyPaths=/run/clinx-rust-provider/native:/tmp/codex-daemon-1200
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/clinx-rust/api
InaccessiblePaths=/var/lib/clinx-rust/authority /home/operator/.codex /home/operator/.ssh /run/user/1001 -/run/docker.sock -/run/containerd
UMask=0077
KillMode=control-group
ExecStart=/release/clinx-mcp --config /var/lib/clinx-rust/config/mcp-runtime.json --stdio
StandardInput=socket
StandardOutput=inherit
StandardError=journal
units.clinx-rust-centre.service:
[Unit]
Description=CLINX Centre Rust projection (pre-cutover loopback)
After=clinx-rust-authority.service
Requires=clinx-rust-authority.service
[Service]
Environment=HOME=/var/lib/clinx-rust/api
Environment=PYTHONPATH=/release/control:/release/deps
Environment=PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
Environment=CLINX_AUTHORITY=rust
Environment=CLINX_RUST_SOCKET=/run/clinx-rust/authority.sock
Environment=CLINX_RUST_UID=1201
User=clinx-api
Group=clinx-api
SupplementaryGroups=clinx-ipc clinx-provider-ipc
NoNewPrivileges=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=read-only
ProtectProc=invisible
ProcSubset=pid
PrivateDevices=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
BindReadOnlyPaths=/run/clinx-rust-provider/native:/tmp/codex-daemon-1200
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/clinx-rust/api
InaccessiblePaths=/var/lib/clinx-rust/authority /home/operator/.codex /home/operator/.ssh /run/user/1001 -/run/docker.sock -/run/containerd
UMask=0077
KillMode=control-group
ExecStart=/release/clinx-node-daemon --state /var/lib/clinx-rust/api/node-centre --node-id p620 serve --registry /var/lib/clinx-rust/api/node-centre/registry.sqlite3 --observations /var/lib/clinx-rust/api/node-centre/observations.sqlite3 --bind 127.0.0.1 --port 18774 --rust-projection --local-owner-host p620 --local-provider-config /var/lib/clinx-rust/config/bridge.toml --stale-after 45
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3

stage_rust_callers.py.tmpfiles:
d /run/clinx-rust 2750 clinx-authority clinx-ipc -
d /run/clinx-rust-provider 2750 worker clinx-provider-ipc -
d /run/clinx-rust-provider/native 0700 worker clinx-provider-ipc -
d /run/clinx-rust-api 0711 root root -
